pages.text: Hitch adult horses or donkeys, not mules. The animal must be on your lead with suitable ground nearby. Animals being ridden, carried or already hitched cannot be attached.$(br2)Use any part of the shafts while holding a lead, even from the wagon. Fill both double-hitch positions. Horse speed attributes do not set wagon speed.

Use shears on a hitched animal to release it and recover its lead. Converting the wagon back to blocks or dismantling it also releases animals and returns leads.$(br2)An animal left unsupported near a cliff for about three seconds detaches and falls. Leave safe ground for both animals and wheels.
